Happy birthday, Prashant

You teach, you build, you plant, you wander and somehow you still make time to explain the history of a random country to me at midnight. You are the smartest person I know and the kindest, and you make everyone around you feel like the most interesting person in the room.

Here's to more mountains, more trees, more terrible road-trip playlists, and a lifetime of random facts. Happy birthday, my favourite human.

With all my love, always.Aashu.
